confirm.title: Add Hilo Band
confirm.description:
Set up {name}?

Passive mode only listens for advertisements and never connects, so it cannot disturb the Hilo app on your phone. Active mode also connects on a slow interval to read battery and storage, which only works while the band is not bonded to your phone.

abort.no_devices_found: No Hilo Band found. Make sure the band is worn or awake and within range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a Hilo Band. The Hilo cuff is a separate device and is not supported here.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to connect in active mode. Keep this long: every connection competes with your phone for the band's single Bluetooth link.

options.active: Active (also connect to read battery and storage)
